items.title_zh: 智元：精灵 G2 机器人在龙旗科技产线正式承担喇叭 BOX 安装任务并实现并线生产
items.title_en: AgiBot: Jingling G2 robot takes on speaker BOX installation and in-line production at Longqi Technology's production line
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，智元今日宣布，旗下机器人精灵 G2 在龙旗科技产线的部署近期再获突破：在质检上下料工序并线稳定运行的基础上，进一步拓展至精密装配环节， 正式承担喇叭 BOX 安装任务并实现并线生产 。 官方表示，这意味着机器人从「搬运型」作业向「精密操作型」作业延伸，同一台机器人无需定制改造即可胜任不同工序， 方案的跨工序复制能力在真实量产环境中再次得到验证 。 据IT之家此前报道，6 月 23 日至 28 日，智元精灵 G2 机器人开启“平板量产质检工段全覆盖”真实产线直播， 机器人作业成功率 99.99% 。 精灵 G2 从高速运行的流水线上抓取待测平板，与测试装备实时通信，将产品放入对应测试治具中，与测试装备信息交互后，将测试完成的合格品与 NG 品分类放回流水线上。 据介绍，智元精灵 G2 在龙旗科技南昌工厂产线进行平板生产质检工段全工序，机器人、测试装备和传输轨道组成最小作业单元，相互协作完成质检任务。 相关阅读： 《 手机测试产线部署智元精灵 G2 机器人，智元与蓝思科技达成战略合作 》 《 智元机器人获龙旗科技数亿元智元精灵 G2 框架订单，将部署近千台机器人 》 《 拥有 19 自由度灵巧手，智元精灵 G2 新一代工业级交互式具身作业机器人发布 》
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 27 that AgiBot announced a further breakthrough in the deployment of its Jingling G2 robot at Longqi Technology's production line: after stable in-line operation in quality-inspection loading and unloading, the robot has extended into precision assembly, formally taking on speaker BOX installation and achieving in-line production. The company said this means the robot has extended from "handling-type" work to "precision-operation-type" work, with a single robot able to handle different processes without customized modification, again validating the solution's cross-process replicability in a real mass-production environment. IT之家 previously reported that from June 23 to 28, AgiBot's Jingling G2 ran a live broadcast of a real production line covering the full tablet mass-production quality-inspection section, with a 99.99% task success rate; at Longqi Technology's Nanchang plant the robot performs all processes of the tablet quality-inspection section, with the robot, test equipment and conveyor track forming a minimum work unit that cooperates to complete inspection tasks. Related reading also mentions AgiBot's strategic cooperation with Lens Technology and AgiBot's order framework worth hundreds of millions of yuan from Longqi Technology for nearly 1,000 robots.
items.why_zh: 推测：这是人形/具身机器人从搬运类任务迈向精密装配的落地案例，可作为其在量产环境中跨工序复用能力的参考。
items.why_en: Speculative: this is a deployment case of embodied robots moving from handling tasks to precision assembly, and may serve as a reference for their ability to be reused across processes in mass production.

items.title_zh: 防考生利用 AI 作弊，韩国学校抢购金属探测器
items.title_en: South Korean schools rush to buy metal detectors to prevent AI-assisted exam cheating
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，据央视新闻报道，为防范考生利用人工智能（AI）设备作弊，韩国教育部近日发布新规，要求所有参加校内考试的学生须在考试前后 接受金属探测器检查 。各地学校加紧采购金属探测器，导致供不应求。 报道提到，一家生产便携式金属探测器的韩国厂商 27 日表示，客户咨询数量较往常增加了约 100 倍，公司大幅提升产量，仍难以满足需求。另一厂商说，如果现在订购，需等待约半个月才能拿到货。一家线上商家也发布公告说，现货已售罄，预计下月初才会补货，目前只接受预订。 在买不到金属探测器的情况下，不少学校转而选择租用设备应急， 租赁公司接到的咨询量显著增多 。一家金属探测器租赁公司的负责人表示，过去一般是有安保要求的活动需要租用金属探测器，租给学校监考还是头一次。 据韩国方面消息，韩国 2027 学年大学录取名额中，超过 80% 将通过提前选拔录取，高中成绩在其中起着关键作用。然而， 常有考生借助微型摄像头等高科技设备实施作弊 ，相关设备藏匿于衣物或随身物品中，难以发现。因此，韩国教育部要求各地学校在校内考试中使用金属探测器；而对于设备不足的学校，韩国教育部将协助其向警察部门等公共机构借用，或与附近学校共享。 IT之家注意到，韩国教育部 27 日公布的数据显示，截至 11 月 25 日，在 2027 学年度大学修学能力考试（高考）中已查处作弊行为 474 起，较去年同期的 279 起增加 69.9%。其中， 涉及智能设备的作弊行为达到 112 起 ，是去年的 3.6 倍，接近全部作弊案例的四分之一。 针对利用智能设备实施的严重作弊行为，教育部已于本月 23 日对 6 名考生提出刑事控告。为防止类似事件再次发生，教育部计划今后加强检查，从源头上阻止可能用于作弊的物品被带入考场。 此外，教育部还将把高考和校内考试的监管标准扩大至其主管的 6 类国家级考试，并提高作弊处罚力度。 据IT之家此前报道，韩国政府为查获考场内未上交的手机，向高考考生与普通民众同步发送了紧急灾难通知短信。短信发送后， 处于开机状态的手机将鸣响 10.5 秒警报 。 相关阅读： 《 韩国高考已查处涉智能设备作弊达 112 起，增至去年 3.6 倍 》 《 韩国防 AI 作弊新招：要求考生穿围裙考试、时隔 6 年重新收缴手机 》 《 韩国高考 AI 作弊事件发酵，教育部长引咎辞职 》 《 韩国教育部认定今年高考共 111 起涉电子设备作弊：利用智能手机拍考卷等 》 《 韩国首次利用紧急灾难通知“0 级短信”打击 AI 辅助作弊行为，成功在高考中抓获 54 名违规考生 》
items.summary_en: IT之家, November 27: according to CCTV News, to prevent test-takers from cheating with artificial intelligence (AI) devices, South Korea's Ministry of Education recently issued new rules requiring all students taking in-school exams to undergo metal detector checks before and after exams, prompting schools to step up purchases and causing shortages. A South Korean maker of portable metal detectors said on the 27th that customer inquiries had risen about 100-fold from usual and that the company had sharply raised output but still could not meet demand; another maker said orders placed now would take about half a month to deliver; an online retailer announced that stock had sold out, with restocking expected early next month and only pre-orders accepted. Unable to buy detectors, many schools turned to renting equipment as an emergency measure, with rental companies seeing a marked rise in inquiries; one rental firm's head said detectors were previously rented for events with security requirements, and renting to schools for exam invigilation was a first. According to South Korean sources, more than 80% of university admission places for the 2027 academic year will be filled through early selection, in which high school grades play a key role, yet test-takers often cheat using high-tech devices such as miniature cameras hidden in clothing or personal items, making them hard to detect; hence the ministry requires schools to use metal detectors in in-school exams, and will help schools short of equipment borrow from police and other public institutions or share with nearby schools. IT之家 notes that data released by the ministry on the 27th shows that, as of November 25, 474 cheating cases had been detected in the 2027 academic year College Scholastic Ability Test (the national college entrance exam), up 69.9% from 279 a year earlier; 112 involved smart devices, 3.6 times last year's figure and nearly a quarter of all cases. For serious cheating using smart devices, the ministry filed criminal complaints against 6 test-takers on the 23rd of this month, and plans tougher inspections to stop items that could be used for cheating from being brought into exam rooms at the source; it will also extend the supervision standards for the national exam and in-school exams to the 6 categories of state-level exams it oversees and increase penalties for cheating. IT之家 previously reported that to catch phones not handed in, the South Korean government sent emergency disaster alert text messages to test-takers and the public alike, after which powered-on phones sound a 10.5-second alarm.
items.why_zh: 推测：这反映出生成式 AI 与智能设备正在改变考试作弊的形态，并推动监考与硬件管控手段升级。
items.why_en: Speculative: this reflects how generative AI and smart devices are changing the nature of exam cheating and driving upgrades in invigilation and hardware controls.

items.title_zh: 美团王兴：与微信小微合作按计划推进，预计明年 AI 资本开支将低于今年
items.title_en: Meituan's Wang Xing: cooperation with WeChat Xiaowei on track, AI capex expected to be lower next year than this year
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，据每日经济新闻，对于市场关注的美团与微信小微的试点合作进展，美团 CEO 王兴在财报发布后的业绩电话会上表示， 双方合作正按计划推进 ，双方聚焦本地服务场景，优先打磨微信生态内完整服务链路。 王兴认为，微信 AI 能力叠加美团本地供给与履约能力， 有望挖掘微信生态内新的本地服务需求 。 在 AI 资本开支上，王兴表示，美团将坚持 ROI（投资回报率）导向、审慎投入。王兴透露， 今年已提前锁定部分算力资源，预计明年 AI 相关资本开支将低于今年 ，投入节奏服从整体财务规划，兼顾业务收益与推理成本，持续优化投入效率。 他同时提到，AI 将持续在研发、客服、运营等环节提效，优化平台推荐与服务体验， 中长期来看，AI 带来的降本增效有望逐步覆盖新增投入 。 据IT之家此前报道， 美团今日发布 2026 财年第三财季 （2026 年 7 月～2026 年 9 月）报告： 营业总收入 ：1155.56 亿元，同比增长 21.6%，环比增长 10.4% 毛利润 ：376.84 亿元，同比增长 52.2%，环比增长 7.38% 毛利率 ：32.61%，同比增长 6.57 个百分点，环比下降 0.93 个百分点 归母净利润 ：20.7 亿元，同比扭亏为盈，环比下降 3.93% 经营现金流 ：47.84 亿元 资产负债率 ：56.13% 相关阅读： 《 美团接入微信 AI 生态，未来提供外卖等 AI 生活服务体验 》
items.summary_en: IT之家, November 27: according to National Business Daily, asked about the progress of Meituan's pilot cooperation with WeChat Xiaowei, Meituan CEO Wang Xing said at the post-earnings conference call that the partnership is advancing as planned, with both sides focused on local services scenarios and prioritizing refinement of a complete service chain within the WeChat ecosystem. Wang believes WeChat's AI capabilities combined with Meituan's local supply and fulfillment capabilities could unlock new local service demand within the WeChat ecosystem. On AI capital expenditure, Wang said Meituan will stay ROI-oriented and invest prudently. He said the company secured some computing resources in advance this year and expects AI-related capex next year to be lower than this year, with the pace of investment subject to overall financial planning, balancing business returns and inference costs and continuously improving investment efficiency. He added that AI will keep improving efficiency in R&D, customer service and operations and optimize platform recommendations and service experience, and that over the medium and long term, the cost reduction and efficiency gains from AI are expected to gradually cover the new investment. IT之家 previously reported that Meituan today released its fiscal 2026 third-quarter report (July–September 2026): total revenue of 115.556 billion yuan, up 21.6% year on year and 10.4% quarter on quarter; gross profit of 37.684 billion yuan, up 52.2% year on year and 7.38% quarter on quarter; gross margin of 32.61%, up 6.57 percentage points year on year and down 0.93 percentage points quarter on quarter; net profit attributable to shareholders of 2.07 billion yuan, turning profitable year on year and down 3.93% quarter on quarter; operating cash flow of 4.784 billion yuan; debt-to-asset ratio of 56.13%. Related reading mentions Meituan joining the WeChat AI ecosystem to offer AI life services such as food delivery in the future.
items.why_zh: 推测：头部平台对 AI 投入转向 ROI 导向，可能影响其与微信等生态合作的节奏及行业算力开支预期。
items.why_en: Speculative: a leading platform shifting AI spending toward ROI may affect the pace of its ecosystem partnerships, such as with WeChat, and industry expectations for compute spending.

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，据每日经济新闻，对于市场关注的美团与微信小微的试点合作进展，美团 CEO 王兴在财报发布后的业绩电话会上表示， 双方合作正按计划推进 ，双方聚焦本地服务场景，优先打磨微信生态内完整服务链路。 王兴认为，微信 AI 能力叠加美团本地供给与履约能力， 有望挖掘微信生态内新的本地服务需求 。 在 AI 资本开支上，王兴表示，美团将坚持 ROI（投资回报率）导向、审慎投入。王兴透露， 今年已提前锁定部分算力资源，预计明年 AI 相关资本开支将低于今年 ，投入节奏服从整体财务规划，兼顾业务收益与推理成本，持续优化投入效率。 他同时提到，AI 将持续在研发、客服、运营等环节提效，优化平台推荐与服务体验， 中长期来看，AI 带来的降本增效有望逐步覆盖新增投入 。 据IT之家此前报道， 美团今日发布 2026 财年第三财季 （2026 年 7 月～2026 年 9 月）报告： 营业总收入 ：1155.56 亿元，同比增长 21.6%，环比增长 10.4% 毛利润 ：376.84 亿元，同比增长 52.2%，环比增长 7.38% 毛利率 ：32.61%，同比增长 6.57 个百分点，环比下降 0.93 个百分点 归母净利润 ：20.7 亿元，同比扭亏为盈，环比下降 3.93% 经营现金流 ：47.84 亿元 资产负债率 ：56.13% 相关阅读： 《 美团接入微信 AI 生态，未来提供外卖等 AI 生活服务体验 》

items.summary_en: IT之家, November 27: WeChat Security Center has published its list of the most popular rumors in Moments for November 2026, covering items such as "regulators require fund companies to report AI exposure of all products" and "vehicle recalls." IT之家 summarizes the items: 01 "Social insurance accounts are zeroed after a three-month lapse?" — the claim is a typical recycled rumor and the "zeroing" description is inaccurate; accrued social insurance benefits do not vanish. Pension records are not zeroed after a lapse; the agency retains the basic pension relationship and all contribution records, the personal account balance keeps accruing interest, and a lapse only slows the accumulation of total contribution time. Medical insurance lapses mainly affect continuous contribution years and benefit eligibility, while personal account funds are not zeroed; many localities treat resuming contributions after a lapse of more than 3 months as re-enrollment, recalculating continuous contribution years and imposing a 3-to-6-month waiting period. (China Labor and Social Security News) 02 "Vehicles are being recalled by manufacturers over safety issues?" — the so-called recall text messages are a scam: a fake "customer service" offers three recall options, the first two requiring repairs at designated 4S dealerships far from the owner's city, steering owners to online processing and step-by-step manipulation that ultimately causes account losses; several affected automakers have issued statements saying these recall notices and attached documents are not official. (WeChat accounts "Shanghai Internet Rumor Refutation," "Nanfang Daily," "Hunan Internet Reporting") 03 "Once you've paid 15 years of pension contributions you can wait for retirement?" — the Xiamen Human Resources and Social Security Bureau in Fujian refuted this, saying that stopping contributions on this belief could leave people unable to receive pensions on time at retirement age due to insufficient contribution years; under the State Council measures on gradually raising the statutory retirement age, from January 1, 2030 the minimum contribution period for monthly basic pensions will rise gradually from 15 to 20 years, increasing by 6 months each year, with the minimum period tied directly to retirement timing. (Xiamen Daily) 04 "Six people spent 510,000 yuan at Shanghai's Peace Hotel?" — the Shanghai Public Security Bureau's Huangpu Branch reported that a head of an out-of-province online liquor sales company, surnamed Zhao, seeking attention and higher sales, organized others to use AI software to alter the Peace Hotel bill amount and substitute liquor information, producing fake videos spread online to market its own liquor off the hotel's brand recognition; 15 people were detained, with Zhao and three others under criminal coercive measures and the other 11 given administrative penalties. (Red Star News; Huangpu Branch) 05 "A doctor in Nanjing, Jiangsu was stabbed to death?" — local health authorities verified that no doctor named "Zhang Minglei" exists in the city's health system and no stabbing of a doctor from a doctor-patient dispute occurred; local veterans affairs authorities also confirmed that the "Nanjing Junhun Guomartyrs Cemetery" mentioned does not exist. (WeChat account "Nanjing Internet Rumor Refutation") 06 "Regulators require fund companies to report AI exposure of all products?" — on November 18, a CSRC spokesperson, answering a reporter's question, said the information was untrue and that public fund investment operations follow the Securities Investment Fund Law and other regulations and fund contracts, with investment targets... items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，国家互联网信息办公室今日发布《全民数字素养与技能调查报告（2026 年）》。 《报告》从总体情况、地区情况、群体情况等方面，系统分析了我国公民数字素养与技能发展水平及变化趋势。调查结果显示， 2026 年我国成年公民中具备初级及以上数字素养与技能的占比为 64.69% ，高级水平占比为 17.65%，较 2024 年分别增长 4.08 个和 1.39 个百分点，全民数字素养与技能发展总体呈良好态势。 从区域维度看，我国公民数字素养与技能发展水平呈现东部地区持续领跑、中部地区稳步跟进、西部地区加速追赶的发展态势。从城乡、年龄、受教育程度、职业等群体维度看，各群体的数字素养与技能发展水平持续向好。 《报告》还首次调查了全民人工智能素养发展情况。调查结果显示， 2026 年我国成年公民中具备初级及以上人工智能素养的占比为 47.46% ，高级水平占比为 4.75%。 IT之家附主要调查结果如下： 1.我国超过 64% 的成年公民具备初级及以上数字素养与技能 。2026 年，我国成年公民中具备初级及以上数字素养与技能的占比为 64.69%，高级水平占比为 17.65%，较 2024 年分别增长 4.08 个、1.39 个百分点，我国数字素养与技能发展呈现良好态势，数字经济发展的社会基础更加坚实。 2.我国东中西部数字素养与技能发展水平呈普遍提升态势 。2026 年，东部、中部、西部地区成年公民初级及以上水平占比分别为 67.43%、63.52%、60.56%，高级水平占比分别为 19.60%、16.41%、15.25%，呈现东部地区持续领跑、中部地区稳步跟进、西部地区加速追赶的发展态势。 3.城乡居民数字素养与技能同步提升 。2026 年，城镇居民和农村居民初级及以上水平占比分别为 71.02%、52.60%，高级水平占比分别为 21.68%、9.96%。相比 2024 年，城乡居民初级及以上水平、高级水平占比均实现增长。 4.各年龄段公民数字素养与技能整体稳步提升 。2026 年，18—29 岁、30—39 岁、40—49 岁、50—59 岁、60—69 岁年龄段公民初级及以上水平占比分别为 82.60%、72.89%、65.58%、54.90%、41.90%，其中青年群体提升明显。 5.受教育程度对公民数字素养与技能影响显著 。2026 年，我国成年公民中，小学及以下、初中、高中 / 中专、大学专科、大学本科及以上学历群体的初级及以上水平占比分别为 36.39%、58.99%、78.58%、88.85%、92.62%，较 2024 年均实现不同程度增长。 6.劳动者数字素养与技能与职业场景密切相关 。2026 年，教育工作者、工程师、新就业群体、医务人员、产业工人、农民的初级及以上水平占比分别达 81.81%、81.44%、80.65%、75.77%、62.69%、45.97%。岗位数字化实践应用频次高的群体，其数字素养与技能相对较高。 7.我国近半数成年公民具备初级及以上人工智能素养 。2026 年，我国成年公民中具备初级及以上人工智能素养的占比为 47.46%，高级水平占比为 4.75%。青年群体、大学本科及以上学历群体、新就业群体等人群的人工智能素养较高。
items.summary_en: IT之家, November 27: the Cyberspace Administration of China today released the 2026 National Survey Report on Digital Literacy and Skills. The survey shows that in 2026, 64.69% of Chinese adult citizens had basic or higher digital literacy and skills, with 17.65% at an advanced level, up 4.08 and 1.39 percentage points respectively from 2024. By region, the shares with basic or higher levels in the eastern, central and western regions were 67.43%, 63.52% and 60.56%, with advanced levels at 19.60%, 16.41% and 15.25%, showing the east leading, the center following and the west catching up. Urban and rural residents' basic-or-higher shares were 71.02% and 52.60%, with advanced levels at 21.68% and 9.96%. Shares with basic or higher levels were 82.60%, 72.89%, 65.58%, 54.90% and 41.90% for the 18–29, 30–39, 40–49, 50–59 and 60–69 age groups. By education, shares with basic or higher levels were 36.39% for primary school or below, 58.99% for junior high, 78.58% for high school/vocational, 88.85% for junior college and 92.62% for bachelor's degree or above. Shares with basic or higher levels were 81.81% for educators, 81.44% for engineers, 80.65% for new-employment groups, 75.77% for medical workers, 62.69% for industrial workers and 45.97% for farmers. The report also surveyed national AI literacy for the first time: in 2026, 47.46% of adult citizens had basic or higher AI literacy and 4.75% had an advanced level, with higher AI literacy among young people, those with bachelor's degrees or above and new-employment groups.
items.why_zh: 推测：官方首次调查全民 AI 素养，可作为衡量 AI 普及程度与数字鸿沟的基线数据。
items.why_en: Speculative: the first official national AI literacy survey may serve as baseline data for measuring AI adoption and the digital divide.

items.title_zh: 已深度服务微信电商数百个业务流程，微信开源 WeMM-Ecom 多模态基础模型家族
items.title_en: WeChat open-sources WeMM-Ecom multimodal foundation model family, already serving hundreds of WeChat e-commerce workflows
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，腾讯微信视觉团队开源 WeMM-Ecom —— 兼顾前沿电商理解与领先通用能力的多模态基础模型家族，涵盖 0.8B、2B、4B、9B 四款稠密模型和 35B-A3B 混合专家模型。 全系列模型原生支持“快速直答”与“深度思考”双模式，并同步开放 BF16、FP8、GPTQ、GGUF 全套权重。 在覆盖 8 大电商场景的 28 项电商基准与 64 项公开通用基准中，WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B 在电商榜单以 74.4 分领先数百 B 旗舰模型 。在 64 项通用基准上，WeMM-Ecom-2B 在轻量级模型中排名第一。目前，WeMM-Ecom 已深度服务微信电商数百个业务流程 ，日均调用量达到十亿量级。 ▲ WeMM-Ecom 电商理解性能总览（28 项电商基准榜单） 据介绍，WeMM-Ecom 全系列基于 Qwen3.5 与微信自研 WeChat-YATT 训练框架，已在微信生态的数百个业务流程中大规模落地， 日均调用量达到十亿量级 。 ▲ WeMM-Ecom 完整训练流程 自动化填好商品档案： 商家上架只需传图，模型自己从多角度主图和密密麻麻的长详情页里读出品牌、材质、净含量和类目，还能标出信息出自哪张图，方便核对。商家少填一堆表单，商品信息也更全。 跨店找同款、分清细微规格： 不管是拿一张截图搜同款，还是判断两家店卖的是不是同一规格 —— 哪怕一家写“500g 单袋”、另一家是“250g × 2 组合装”，或者商家漏填了参数栏只写在标题里，模型也能准确分辨，直接用来做商品搜索和导购比价。 给商品上架把好合规关： 结合平台规则看图对标题，自动排查违禁品、缺资质、图文不符，顺带检查短标题写得规不规范。重复的初筛交给模型，人工审核可以盯紧更疑难的案子。 找准细节，也看得懂直播画面： 能在复杂海报里精准框出商品主体、品牌 Logo、资质证照和尺寸标注，图里没有的东西会直接说没有、不胡编；放到不断晃动的直播间里，也能实时标出主播正在展示的商品，辅助核对直播挂车有没有对上号。 ▲ WeMM-Ecom 覆盖的八大电商核心场景与任务示意 IT之家附相关链接： 论文链接： https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30662 代码仓库： https://github.com/Tencent/WeMM-Ecom 模型合集： https://huggingface.co/collections/tencent/wemm-ecom
items.summary_en: IT之家, November 27: Tencent's WeChat Vision team has open-sourced WeMM-Ecom, a multimodal foundation model family balancing frontier e-commerce understanding with leading general capabilities, covering four dense models (0.8B, 2B, 4B, 9B) and a 35B-A3B mixture-of-experts model. The whole series natively supports both "fast direct answer" and "deep thinking" modes and releases full BF16, FP8, GPTQ and GGUF weights. Across 28 e-commerce benchmarks covering 8 major e-commerce scenarios and 64 public general benchmarks, WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B leads flagship models of hundreds of billions of parameters on the e-commerce leaderboard with 74.4 points, while WeMM-Ecom-2B ranks first among lightweight models on the 64 general benchmarks. WeMM-Ecom already deeply serves hundreds of business workflows in WeChat e-commerce, with daily calls in the billions. The series is based on Qwen3.5 and WeChat's self-developed WeChat-YATT training framework. Applications include: automatically filling in product records (reading brand, material, net content and category from multi-angle main images and long detail pages and marking which image the information came from); cross-store same-item search and distinguishing subtle specifications (such as "500g single bag" versus "250g × 2 combo," or parameters missing from the spec table and only in the title); listing compliance checks (flagging prohibited goods, missing qualifications and image-text mismatches per platform rules, plus checking short-title compliance); and locating product subjects, brand logos, qualification certificates and size annotations in posters, stating when something is not in the image instead of making it up, and marking in real time which product a host is showing in live streams.
items.why_zh: 推测：这是少见的将电商多模态模型开源并披露十亿级日调用量的案例，或有助于电商 AI 应用的复现与比较。
items.why_en: Speculative: this is a rare case of open-sourcing e-commerce multimodal models alongside disclosed billion-scale daily usage, which may aid reproduction and comparison of e-commerce AI applications.

items.title_en: Volcano Engine: Doubao models now serve 80% of leading Chinese TV makers, with Skyworth, Changhong, Hisense and TCL shipping mass-produced TVs
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，字节火山引擎今日宣布，目前， 豆包大模型已服务八成国内头部电视厂商， 创维、长虹、海信、TCL 等主流品牌，都推出了搭载豆包大模型的量产电视。 围绕豆包大模型版电视，火山引擎提供模型与接入支持，厂商完成硬件和系统适配，抖音电商提供渠道与内容营销支持。 实时语音智能体负责与用户交流： 通过豆包语音模型、多模态模型理解需求，借助搜索、技能与记忆能力处理请求、衔接上下文。想查信息，可以调用搜索；想做内容，可以调用生成服务。相比传统“语音识别 + 小模型意图路由”的方案，大模型能更准确地理解用户意图，语气和情感表达也更自然。用户不必记住固定指令，用日常说话的方式就能表达需求。 云端智能体处理需要调用长程任务的需求： 云端可以连接内容生成、豆包问答、豆包爱学等服务，也支持接入电视品牌自建的观影、学习、健康等智能体。火山方舟提供运行时、技能调用、记忆与凭证等配套支持，帮助对话与场景服务协作。 据介绍，不同品牌可以根据产品定位选择服务，也能把已有内容和功能接进来，把豆包能力做成各自的体验。 ▲ 豆包大模型电视场景解决方案 IT之家获悉，2026 年双十一期间，创维（含酷开）、长虹、海信、TCL（含雷鸟）等品牌的豆包大模型版电视， 在抖音电商渠道整体销售额破亿 。
items.summary_en: IT之家, November 27: ByteDance's Volcano Engine announced today that Doubao large models now serve 80% of leading Chinese TV manufacturers, with mainstream brands including Skyworth, Changhong, Hisense and TCL all launching mass-produced TVs powered by Doubao models. For Doubao-model TVs, Volcano Engine provides models and integration support, manufacturers handle hardware and system adaptation, and Douyin E-commerce provides channel and content marketing support. A real-time voice agent handles user interaction: understanding requests via Doubao speech and multimodal models and handling them with search, skills and memory capabilities to maintain context; users can call search for information or generation services for content. Compared with traditional "speech recognition + small-model intent routing" approaches, large models understand user intent more accurately and express tone and emotion more naturally, so users need not memorize fixed commands. A cloud agent handles requests requiring long-horizon tasks: the cloud can connect to content generation, Doubao Q&A and Doubao Aixue services, and supports TV brands' own agents for viewing, learning and health; Volcano Ark provides runtime, skill invocation, memory and credential support. Different brands can choose services based on product positioning and integrate existing content and features. items.title_zh: 探索用 AI 在大银幕“复活”李小龙，其女儿李香凝称像是在走钢丝
items.title_en: Bruce Lee's Daughter Shannon Lee on Reviving Him On-Screen With AI: 'Like Walking a Tightrope'
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，据新浪电影今日报道，李小龙女儿李香凝在新加坡金狮大赏“人工智能时代下的华语电影”论坛上提到，近年越来越多人提出，是否可以用 AI 技术让李小龙的形象重返大银幕，她也一直在思考怎样应对是合适的。随后武贝导演透露，因为李小龙先生留下了大量清晰影像， 他现在已经在与李香凝一起，探索一些用技术手段让李小龙先生在大银幕“复活”的可能性 。 图源：Pexels 李香凝：“当某个东西 100% 由 AIGC 生成时，确实会让人觉得缺乏灵魂，缺失了某种生命力。我认为我们需要找到方法让人类与 AI 进行互动，打造出好的艺术作品。话虽如此，我认为那些仅仅想利用它来最大化利润的人缺乏长远的眼光。 我们需要确保人的参与，这样我们才能继续与我们所创造的事物建立深层次的连接 。 所以，这会是一个挑战。我能理解 AIGC 现在给了我一个机会，能让我再次在大银幕上看到我的父亲。但说实话，当我在银幕上看到他时，又觉得有点毛骨悚然。但我知道很多人很喜欢这种形式。所以， 这就像是在走钢丝 ，对吧？利用这项新技术来继续传承我父亲的文化遗产，怎样的结合比例才是正确的？又不能任由其肆意发展，因为我父亲比任何人都更相信‘人’本身，相信自我和真实。作为一个人，他的目标之一就是让别人看到他时会说：‘看那个人，多真诚，多真实。’然而现在我们面对的却是一个不真实的东西。 所以对我来说，这无关利润。这是关于如何找到正确的方式去致敬我的父亲和他的遗产 。如果人们过于关注利润，我们就会忘了‘人’本身，我认为这是一个错误。我没有答案，但我感谢你提出这个话题。” 延伸阅读 李小龙 1940 年 11 月 27 日出生于美国旧金山，1973 年 7 月 20 日在香港去世，年仅 32 岁。其代表作品包括《唐山大兄》《精武门》《猛龙过江》《龙争虎斗》等，其中《猛龙过江》由他自编自导自演。 论坛举行的 11 月 27 日，恰是李小龙的 86 岁冥诞。 李香凝是李小龙的女儿。2008 年，她向环球电影公司购回了李小龙的影像权，并先后成立负责特许事务的李小龙企业公司（Bruce Lee Enterprises）以及负责影片制作的 Lee Way 媒体公司。此外，李小龙之子、李香凝的哥哥李国豪（Brandon Lee）也投身银幕，1993 年 4 月拍摄电影《乌鸦》（The Crow）时因道具枪意外中弹身亡，年仅 28 岁。 文章提到的金狮大赏（Golden Singa Awards）是新加坡面向华语电影设立的电影奖项，由导演武贝担任联合创始人，本届评审之一即为李香凝。据其官方信息，该奖项设 20 个类别，颁奖典礼于 2026 年 11 月 28 日在新加坡圣淘沙名胜世界会议中心举行，参评影片需为 2025 年 6 月 1 日至 2026 年 6 月 30 日期间在影院或流媒体平台首映、时长超过 60 分钟、且至少 50% 对白为中文（含方言及手语）的华语电影。 武贝（又名周文武贝）出生于上海，是导演、编剧、制片人，中国电影家协会会员，新加坡国际华语电影金狮大赏创始人，代表作有《绝命航班》《蒸发太平洋》《独家头条》等。 据论坛透露的信息，李香凝与武贝正共同开发运用 AIGC 工具“复活”李小龙的影视项目，目前体裁、平台及长度均未确定，但定位面向新时代年轻人，故事和世界观被形容为“极具颠覆性”。 近年来已有多位已故或息影艺人的形象被以 AI 数字人形式“复活”或“复出”，例如王祖贤授权自己年轻时的形象用于全 AI 生成的短片《倩影》，吴启华授权 20 岁时的肖像用于 AI 影视，游本昌则将脸和声音交给 AI 拍摄微短剧。对于这一现象，演员梁朝伟曾公开表示不会授权 AI 生成表演，认为“AI 的表演没有灵魂”。
items.summary_en: According to Sina Film, Bruce Lee's daughter Shannon Lee said at the Golden Singa Awards forum "Chinese-Language Cinema in the Age of AI" in Singapore that more and more people in recent years have asked whether AI technology could bring Bruce Lee's image back to the big screen, and that she has been thinking about how best to handle it. Director Wu Bei then revealed that because Bruce Lee left a large amount of clear footage, he is already working with Shannon Lee to explore the possibility of using technology to "revive" Bruce Lee on the big screen. Shannon Lee said: "When something is 100% generated by AIGC, it does feel soulless, missing some kind of life force. I think we need to find ways for humans to interact with AI to create good art. That said, I think those who just want to use it to maximize profit lack long-term vision. We need to ensure human participation so that we can continue to build a deep connection with what we create. So this will be a challenge. I understand that AIGC now gives me a chance to see my father on the big screen again. But honestly, when I see him on screen, it feels a bit creepy. But I know many people like this form. So it's like walking a tightrope, right? Using this new technology to continue my father's legacy — what is the right ratio? And it can't be allowed to develop unchecked, because my father believed in 'people' themselves, in the self and in authenticity, more than anyone. As a person, one of his goals was for people to see him and say: 'Look at that man, how sincere, how real.' Yet now we are facing something unreal. So for me, this is not about profit. It is about finding the right way to honor my father and his legacy. If people focus too much on profit, we will forget 'people' themselves, and I think that is a mistake. I don't have the answer, but I thank you for raising this topic." The report adds: Bruce Lee was born in San Francisco on November 27, 1940, and died in Hong Kong on July 20, 1973, at just 32; his works include "The Big Boss," "Fist of Fury," "The Way of the Dragon" and "Enter the Dragon," with "The Way of the Dragon" written, directed by and starring him; the forum was held on November 27, which would have been Bruce Lee's 86th birthday. Shannon Lee bought back the rights to Bruce Lee's footage from Universal in 2008 and founded Bruce Lee Enterprises and Lee Way Media. Her brother Brandon Lee died at 28 in April 1993 after being shot by a prop gun while filming "The Crow." The Golden Singa Awards is a Singapore film award for Chinese-language cinema, co-founded by Wu Bei, with Shannon Lee among this year's jurors; it has 20 categories, with the ceremony to be held on November 28, 2026 at Resorts World Sentosa Convention Centre in Singapore, and eligible films must have premiered in cinemas or on streaming platforms between June 1, 2025 and June 30, 2026, run longer than 60 minutes, and have at least 50% of dialogue in Chinese (including dialects and sign language). Wu Bei (also known as Zhou Wenwubei) was born in Shanghai and is a director, screenwriter and producer, a member of the China Film Association, and the creator of the Golden Singa Awards, with works including "Last Flight," "Evaporating Pacific" and "Exclusive Headline." According to the forum, Shannon Lee and Wu Bei are co-developing a film/TV project using AIGC tools to "revive" Bruce Lee; the format, platform and length are undecided, it is positioned for young audiences of the new era, and the story and worldview were described as "highly subversive." The report also notes that in recent years several deceased or retired entertainers' images have been "revived" or brought back as AI digital humans — for example Joey Wong authorized her younger likeness for the fully AI-generated short film "Qian Ying," Ng Kai Fai authorized his 20-year-old portrait for AI film/TV, and You Benchang handed his face and voice to AI for a micro-drama; actor Tony Leung has publicly said he would not authorize AI-generated performances, arguing that "AI performances have no soul."
items.why_zh: 这是 AI 数字人"复活"逝者中文化敏感度最高的案例之一，家属本人公开表达"毛骨悚然"与"走钢丝"的矛盾心态，可能影响行业对逝者形象 AI 授权的伦理与商业边界（推测）。
items.why_en: This is one of the most culturally sensitive cases of AI "reviving" the deceased, with the family member herself publicly describing conflicting feelings of creepiness and walking a tightrope — potentially shaping industry norms on ethics and commerce for AI licensing of deceased public figures (speculative).

items.summary_zh: 由 42 位美国州总检察长组成的联盟正试图阻止 Character.AI 在破产法第 11 章程序中出售用户数据。多份几乎相同的新闻稿称，该公司计划拍卖"超过 2100 万个美国账户的私密聊天记录——其中逾 210 万个账户注册人为未成年人——且未对聊天记录被出售所涉人群提供任何保障"。报道称，Character.AI 在经历了多年丑闻与法律挑战（包括来自迪士尼的挑战）后于 10 月申请破产，迪士尼最终收购了该公司部分资产并聘用了其 CEO。完整报道见 The Verge。
items.summary_en: A coalition of 42 state attorneys general is trying to prevent Character.AI from selling off user data as it navigates Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings. In October, Character.AI filed for bankruptcy following years of scandals and legal challenges , including from Disney . items.summary_zh: 报道称，谷歌去年申请了一项名为 My Channel 的系统专利，旨在基于公司掌握的用戶信息，生成充满个性化、AI 生成视频和广告的信息流。该专利申请已被驳回，但谷歌可能提出上诉或提交修改版本，该系统仍有可能进入市场。据 Patentlyze 首先发现，这项于去年 5 月提交、上周公布的专利描述了 My Channel 如何利用人口统计数据与观看历史自行生成提示词，再输入大语言模型，以帮助生成针对该用户的定制 AI 视频。完整报道见 The Verge。

items.title_zh: 支付宝车载助手 3.0 与 80 多家车企达成定点合作，含比亚迪、理想、奇瑞等
items.title_en: Alipay In-Car Assistant 3.0 Reaches Nomination Deals with 80+ Automakers, Including BYD, Li Auto and Chery
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，支付宝今日发布“支付宝车载助手 3.0”，官方称其为 AI 原生车载智能体，让汽车座舱从“会聊天”升级到“能办事”。 IT之家从官方信息获悉，目前已有 80 多个汽车品牌与支付宝车载助手 3.0 达成定点合作， 比亚迪、理想、奇瑞、神行者、东风奕派、东风风神、深蓝、北汽极狐 等品牌的相关车型陆续量产交付，极氪等多个品牌将在广州车展后启动 OTA 升级。 据介绍， 点外卖、购电影票、加油、高速通行 等服务正在进入汽车座舱。用户无需反复打开不同 App、搜索服务或手动查单，从语音提出需求到完成下单、支付，车载助手可一站式完成。 官方举例称，车辆发现油量不足时会主动推荐附近加油站并联动导航；加完油后，车辆识别油枪订单，车主全程不用下车，说句话即可完成支付。想喝咖啡时，车机可结合用户偏好主动询问“还是大杯加冰拿铁吗”，下单时用上优惠券，到达目的地时外卖已送达。 安全方面，车载助手 3.0 上线 声纹核身支付 ，用户授权后，语音即可完成身份核验与支付确认。官方称，蚂蚁集团 APASS 可信授权能力会对服务账号和授权凭证进行独立加密保护，AI 只能在车主授权范围内调用服务，车主也可随时查看、调整或撤销授权。
items.summary_en: Alipay released "Alipay In-Car Assistant 3.0," which it describes as an AI-native in-car agent that upgrades the cockpit from "being able to chat" to "being able to get things done." According to official information, more than 80 car brands have reached nomination agreements for the assistant; models from brands including BYD, Li Auto, Chery, Shenxingzhe, Dongfeng Yipai, Dongfeng Fengshen, Deepal and BAIC Arcfox are being mass-produced and delivered, while several brands such as Zeekr will begin OTA upgrades after the Guangzhou auto show. Services such as ordering takeout, buying movie tickets, refueling and highway tolls are entering the cockpit, letting users go from a voice request to ordering and payment in one flow. Alipay's examples: when the car detects low fuel it proactively recommends a nearby station and links navigation; after refueling it recognizes the fuel-gun order so the owner can pay with a single spoken command; for coffee, the system can proactively ask "the usual large iced latte?" based on preferences and apply coupons when ordering. On security, Assistant 3.0 introduces voiceprint-verified payment, where after user authorization a voice command completes identity verification and payment confirmation; Alipay says Ant Group's APASS trusted authorization capability independently encrypts service accounts and authorization credentials, so the AI can only invoke services within the scope the owner authorizes, and owners can view, adjust or revoke authorization at any time.

items.why_en: Speculation: if the partnerships scale as described, in-car voice payments could become a new gateway for automotive services, though the figures and security claims come from the vendor and have not been independently verified.

items.title_zh: 长城发布全球首个量产大电量真智能 HEV 架构“Hi-HEV”：电池容量翻 2-3 倍，首搭魏牌高山 8
items.title_en: Great Wall Unveils Hi-HEV Architecture, Claimed as World's First Mass-Produced High-Capacity Intelligent HEV, Debuting in Wey Alpine 8
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，长城汽车今日在广州车展发布 Hi-HEV 混动架构，官方称其为“全球首个量产大电量真智能 HEV 架构”，首搭车型魏牌高山 8 已量产落地。 官方介绍称，Hi-HEV 全称为 Hyper-Intelligent HEV（超级智能 HEV），以归元全动力技术为底座，主打智慧动力、智享空间、智能安全，目标是打破 “燃油、HEV 车型与智能化无缘” 的固有认知。 据官方公布信息，Hi-HEV 的电池容量比普通 HEV 高 2-3 倍，放电功率高 3.5 倍， 最大放电功率超过 250kW ，三擎协同下零百加速达到 5 秒级，官方称比同级 HEV 至少快 2.4 秒。 官方称，该架构行业首发 AI 动力算法，可对前方 400m 路况进行实时预测，实现燃油与电能的精准分配；首搭车型魏牌高山 8 HEV 综合油耗低至 6L 级。能量回收方面，官方称刹车寿命提升 2.5-3 倍。 座舱方面，Hi-HEV 搭载 Coffee AIOS 4，支持吸顶屏与座椅按摩，并提供 220V/2.2kW 外放电，行车与原地均可补电。官方称，这是国内量产 HEV 中 唯一原厂 220V/2.2kW 外放电 。 安全方面，该架构搭载 iTVC 2.0 系统，毫秒级调配动力；电池减重 218kg，架构吸能空间提升，官方称碰撞能量降低 15%。 IT之家此前报道，首搭车型魏牌高山 8 HEV 上市发布会定档 10 月 26 日，预订价 27.58 万元起。该车长宽高为 5280mm、1960mm、1900mm，轴距 3145mm，提供 7 种配色；搭载 Coffee Pilot 3 辅助驾驶系统，全车配备 27 个高精传感器与 192 线激光雷达。 动力上，魏牌高山 8 HEV 采用 2.0T 混动专用发动机搭配前后双电机，系统最大功率 322kW、最大扭矩 782N・m，零百加速 5.9 秒，WLTC 综合工况油耗 6.92L/100km。
items.summary_en: Great Wall Motor unveiled its Hi-HEV hybrid architecture at the Guangzhou auto show, calling it "the world's first mass-produced high-capacity, truly intelligent HEV architecture," with the Wey Alpine 8 as the first model, already in production. Great Wall says Hi-HEV (Hyper-Intelligent HEV) is built on its Guiyuan all-powertrain technology and focuses on smart power, smart cabin space and smart safety, aiming to break the assumption that combustion and HEV models cannot be intelligent. Per the company, battery capacity is 2-3 times that of ordinary HEVs, discharge power is 3.5 times higher with a maximum of over 250kW, and three-power-source coordination yields 0-100 km/h acceleration in the 5-second range — at least 2.4 seconds quicker than同级 HEVs, it claims. Great Wall says the architecture debuts an industry-first AI power algorithm that predicts road conditions up to 400m ahead in real time to allocate fuel and electric power precisely; the Alpine 8 HEV's combined fuel consumption is as low as the 6L class, and brake life is improved 2.5-3 times. The cabin runs Coffee AIOS 4 with a roof-mounted screen and seat massage, plus 220V/2.2kW external discharge available while driving or parked — claimed as the only factory 220V/2.2kW external discharge among domestically mass-produced HEVs. Safety features include the iTVC 2.0 system with millisecond-level power distribution, a 218kg lighter battery, and what the company says is 15% lower collision energy. IT之家 previously reported the Alpine 8 HEV launch event is set for October 26 with pre-order prices from 275,800 yuan; dimensions are 5280/1960/1900mm with a 3145mm wheelbase, seven colors, Coffee Pilot 3 assisted driving, 27 high-precision sensors and a 192-line lidar. Power comes from a 2.0T hybrid-dedicated engine with front and rear motors, 322kW and 782N·m system output, 0-100 km/h in 5.9 seconds and WLTC combined consumption of 6.92L/100km.
items.why_zh: 推测：若大电量 HEV 与 AI 能量管理确能量产兑现，混动车型的智能化定位或将被重新界定，但上述性能数据均为厂商自述。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，长城汽车今日在广州车展发布 Hi-HEV 混动架构，官方称其为“全球首个量产大电量真智能 HEV 架构”，首搭车型魏牌高山 8 已量产落地。 官方介绍称，Hi-HEV 全称为 Hyper-Intelligent HEV（超级智能 HEV），以归元全动力技术为底座，主打智慧动力、智享空间、智能安全，目标是打破 “燃油、HEV 车型与智能化无缘” 的固有认知。 据官方公布信息，Hi-HEV 的电池容量比普通 HEV 高 2-3 倍，放电功率高 3.5 倍， 最大放电功率超过 250kW ，三擎协同下零百加速达到 5 秒级，官方称比同级 HEV 至少快 2.4 秒。 官方称，该架构行业首发 AI 动力算法，可对前方 400m 路况进行实时预测，实现燃油与电能的精准分配；首搭车型魏牌高山 8 HEV 综合油耗低至 6L 级。能量回收方面，官方称刹车寿命提升 2.5-3 倍。 座舱方面，Hi-HEV 搭载 Coffee AIOS 4，支持吸顶屏与座椅按摩，并提供 220V/2.2kW 外放电，行车与原地均可补电。官方称，这是国内量产 HEV 中 唯一原厂 220V/2.2kW 外放电 。 安全方面，该架构搭载 iTVC 2.0 系统，毫秒级调配动力；电池减重 218kg，架构吸能空间提升，官方称碰撞能量降低 15%。 IT之家此前报道，首搭车型魏牌高山 8 HEV 上市发布会定档 10 月 26 日，预订价 27.58 万元起。该车长宽高为 5280mm、1960mm、1900mm，轴距 3145mm，提供 7 种配色；搭载 Coffee Pilot 3 辅助驾驶系统，全车配备 27 个高精传感器与 192 线激光雷达。 动力上，魏牌高山 8 HEV 采用 2.0T 混动专用发动机搭配前后双电机，系统最大功率 322kW、最大扭矩 782N・m，零百加速 5.9 秒，WLTC 综合工况油耗 6.92L/100km。

items.title_zh: 小米汽车世界模型 2.0 发布，已在实际业务场景中落地
items.title_en: Xiaomi Auto Releases World Model 2.0, Already Deployed in Real Business Scenarios
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，小米汽车今日正式发布 Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0（小米汽车世界模型 2.0）。 官方称小米汽车世界模型 2.0 进一步将多视角视频生成、物理交互建模、三维场景重建与动作建模连接起来，为辅助驾驶和具身智能统一因果世界模型带来新的范式。 据介绍，模型支持 1—7 路摄像头视角 ，训练语料规模达到 1,260 万段视频片段 ，并展示了从辅助驾驶、机器人场景生成，到闭环仿真与 World Action Model 的多项结果，在多个主流基准测试中全面取得 SOTA，并已在小米汽车合成数据、仿真测试等核心场景完成业务落地应用。 在 PAI-Bench-G 评测中，世界模型 2.0 的驾驶视频生成质量评分为 78.0 ，机器人视频生成质量评分为 77.1 ，均为项目主页所列对比方法中的最高分。 在感知理解任务上，世界模型 2.0 同样获得对比方法中最佳的指标结果。相比于前 SOTA 方法 VGGT-World，世界模型 2.0 在不同的数据序列上均取得最优结果，说明它不只在特定的数据序列上表现好，对其他数据序列也有很强的泛化能力。 在闭环训练任务中，使用世界模型 2.0 作为策略模型的世界模型仿真器，通过对策略模型预测的动作序列进行实际推演与奖励反馈，可以大幅提升策略模型的各项安全指标。在 1,000 个闭环仿真场景中，E2E-WM-RL 方案的碰撞率为 0.4% ，相比 ST-JEPA-E2E 的 1.2% 大大降低；场景完成率达到 96.3% ，高于对比方案的 95.2%，取得更优结果。 世界模型还可以为世界动作模型提供环境动态和未来状态信息。在 NAVSIM v1.1 navtest 实验中，引入因果世界模型条件后，驾驶策略 PDMS 由 Base 模型的 94.9 提升至 95.3 。 在 LIBERO Plus 机器人策略评测中，项目报告的加权平均成功率为 75.0% 。其中，机器人相关任务成功率为 74.7%，语言相关任务为 95.3%，光照相关任务为 97.5%。 WorldRec2.0 在公开的 Waymo 数据集上，全面领先此前 SOTA 方法 WorldRec1.0 与 DGGT，PSNR（衡量重建精度的核心指标，越高越好）达到 25.81。 据介绍，小米汽车世界模型 2.0 通过大规模多源数据学习视觉与物理动态先验，通过多视角与时间建模理解场景演化，通过 WorldRec 2.0 建立持久三维场景上下文，并借助流式生成和蒸馏提升长时序推理效率。 IT之家获悉， 小米汽车世界模型 2.0 已在小米汽车实际业务场景中落地 ： 合成数据生成：已交付超过 20 万 clips 高质量合成数据，直接用于感知模型 / 感知基模训练，提升车辆在危险场景下的识别能力。 仿真测试：构建闭环仿真环境，优化测试效率，完备测试规范，可在仿真中复现真实事故并进行定向优化。 小米汽车持续研发推进预训练与闭环训练范式，推动端到端模型的认知能力跃升。 参考 项目主页 技术报告
items.summary_en: Xiaomi Auto officially released Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0. The company says the model further connects multi-view video generation, physical interaction modeling, 3D scene reconstruction and action modeling, offering a new paradigm for a unified causal world model for assisted driving and embodied intelligence. The model supports 1-7 camera views, was trained on 12.6 million video clips, and the project shows results spanning assisted driving and robot scenario generation to closed-loop simulation and a World Action Model; Xiaomi says it achieves state-of-the-art results across several mainstream benchmarks and has been deployed in core business scenarios such as synthetic data and simulation testing. On PAI-Bench-G, World Model 2.0 scored 78.0 for driving video generation quality and 77.1 for robot video generation quality, the highest among the comparison methods listed on the project page; it also posted the best metrics among compared methods on perception and understanding tasks. Against the previous state of the art, VGGT-World, World Model 2.0 achieved the best results across different data sequences, indicating generalization beyond a specific sequence. In closed-loop training, using World Model 2.0 as the policy model's world-model simulator — rolling out predicted action sequences with reward feedback — substantially improved safety metrics: across 1,000 closed-loop simulation scenarios, the E2E-WM-RL scheme had a 0.4% collision rate versus 1.2% for ST-JEPA-E2E, and a 96.3% scenario completion rate versus 95.2%. The world model can also supply environment dynamics and future-state information to world action models; in NAVSIM v1.1 navtest experiments, adding the causal world model condition raised driving policy PDMS from 94.9 (Base) to 95.3. On the LIBERO Plus robot policy benchmark, the project reports a 75.0% weighted average success rate, including 74.7% on robot-related tasks, 95.3% on language-related tasks and 97.5% on lighting-related tasks. WorldRec 2.0 leads prior state-of-the-art methods WorldRec 1.0 and DGGT on the public Waymo dataset, with PSNR reaching 25.81. According to Xiaomi, the model learns visual and physical dynamics priors from large-scale multi-source data, understands scene evolution through multi-view and temporal modeling, builds persistent 3D scene context via WorldRec 2.0, and improves long-horizon reasoning efficiency with streaming generation and distillation. IT之家 notes the model is already deployed in Xiaomi Auto's real business scenarios: in synthetic data generation it has delivered over 200,000 high-quality synthetic clips, used directly to train perception models and perception foundation models and improve recognition in hazardous scenarios; in simulation testing it has built a closed-loop simulation environment to improve testing efficiency and reproduce real accidents for targeted optimization. Xiaomi Auto says it will continue advancing pretraining and closed-loop training paradigms to raise the cognitive capability of end-to-end models.

items.title_zh: 李健：荣耀 700 系列手机销量已打破 2026 年安卓新品首销日纪录
items.title_en: Li Jian: Honor 700 series sales break 2026 Android new product first-day sales record
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，荣耀终端股份有限公司 CEO 李健宣布， 荣耀 700 系列今天 10:08 开售以来， 销量已打破 2026 年安卓新品首销日纪录 ，成功登顶安卓首销排行榜第一。 据IT之家此前报道， 荣耀 700 系列手机于 11 月 23 日发布 ，包含 荣耀 700S 、荣耀 700、 荣耀 700 Pro 三款产品，首销 3399 元起，国补到手价 2899-5099 元。 荣耀 700 系列配备一块 6.57 英寸 1.5K 120Hz LTPS 绿洲护眼屏，配备 1.59 英寸 AI 灵动背屏；搭载 200Mp 1/1.56" 主摄（荣耀 700 / Pro）、12Mp 超广角、50Mp 3.5X 潜望长焦（荣耀 700 / Pro）。 性能方面，荣耀 700 手机搭载骁龙 8s Gen4、700S 手机搭载骁龙 7 Gen4，而 Pro 机型搭载骁龙 8 Gen5 处理器。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 27 that Li Jian, CEO of Honor Terminal Co., Ltd., announced that since the Honor 700 series went on sale at 10:08 today, its sales have broken the 2026 Android new product first-day sales record and topped the Android first-sale ranking. According to IT之家’s earlier report, the Honor 700 series was launched on November 23 and includes the Honor 700S, Honor 700, and Honor 700 Pro, with first-sale prices starting at 3,399 yuan and national-subsidy final prices of 2,899–5,099 yuan. The Honor 700 series features a 6.57-inch 1.5K 120Hz LTPS Oasis eye-protection screen and a 1.59-inch AI dynamic back screen; it has a 200MP 1/1.56-inch main camera (Honor 700 / Pro), a 12MP ultra-wide camera, and a 50MP 3.5X periscope telephoto camera (Honor 700 / Pro). In terms of performance, the Honor 700 uses Snapdragon 8s Gen4, the 700S uses Snapdragon 7 Gen4, and the Pro model uses Snapdragon 8 Gen5.
items.why_zh: 推测：公司称该系列打破首销日纪录，若数据准确，可能显示荣耀新品的初期需求较强；该纪录说法来自厂商公布，尚需独立验证。
items.why_en: Speculation: the company says the series broke a first-day sales record; if accurate, this may indicate strong initial demand for Honor’s new lineup. The record claim comes from the manufacturer and still needs independent verification.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，小米智能生态今日宣布，小米智能门锁 5 系列两款新品开启预售。 小米智能门锁 5 单摄版新增 2K 超清智能猫眼，升级支持微信小程序开锁、视频通话远程开锁，支持猫眼遮挡提醒， 到手价 1199 元 。 小米智能门锁 5 单摄版搭载新一代 AI 半导体指纹识别技术，识别速度 ≤0.7 秒，识别率 ≥99.53%，支持关门疾速自动上锁；搭配直插式 C 级锁芯，锁体内置 4 个检测开关，可全天候监测锁体状态。 京东 小米智能门锁 5 单摄版 到手价 1199 元 领 0.9 元券 小米智能门锁 5 大屏猫眼版门锁内面板嵌入 3.97 英寸高清可视大屏，访客按响门铃后门内屏幕自动亮起，老人、小孩不用弯腰找传统猫眼就能直接看清门外情况，也可随时手动唤醒屏幕查看门外异常， 到手价 1399 元 。 夜间楼道暗光环境下，摄像头搭载 4 颗红外补光灯，自动在微光全彩、黑白夜视两种模式间切换，昏暗场景也能看清门外细节。 京东 小米智能门锁 5 大屏猫眼版 到手价 1399 元 领 0.9 元券 全系提供 11 种开锁方式，覆盖 AI 指纹、长期密码、访客密码、微信小程序、手机蓝牙、远程开锁、机械钥匙，以及小米手机 / 手表 / 手环 NFC、NFC 卡片等方式，适配老人、小孩、访客等不同家庭成员的使用习惯。 IT之家获悉，两款产品均采用双模智能供电设计，内置一块 5000mAh 锂电池可实现 4 个月续航，搭配 4 节 5 号碱性干电池可实现 6 个月续航，锂电池电量 ≤10% 时自动推送低电量提醒；门锁内外均配备 Type-C 接口，门外接口可外接充电宝应急供电临时开锁，门内接口可外接充电宝持续充电或直连电源长时供电。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 27 that Xiaomi Smart Ecosystem announced today that two new products in the Xiaomi Smart Door Lock 5 series have opened pre-sale. The Xiaomi Smart Door Lock 5 single-camera edition adds a 2K ultra-clear smart peephole, upgrades to support WeChat mini program unlocking and video-call remote unlocking, supports peephole obstruction reminders, and has a final price of 1,199 yuan. The Xiaomi Smart Door Lock 5 single-camera edition features a new-generation AI semiconductor fingerprint recognition technology, with recognition speed ≤0.7 seconds and recognition rate ≥99.53%, and supports rapid automatic locking when the door closes; it uses a straight-insert C-level lock cylinder, and the lock body has 4 detection switches for all-weather monitoring of lock body status. On JD, the Xiaomi Smart Door Lock 5 single-camera edition has a final price of 1,199 yuan, with a 0.9 yuan coupon available. The Xiaomi Smart Door Lock 5 large-screen peephole edition embeds a 3.97-inch HD visual screen in the inner panel; when a visitor rings the doorbell, the indoor screen automatically lights up, so elderly people and children can directly see outside without bending down to find a traditional peephole, and the screen can also be manually woken at any time to check abnormalities outside; its final price is 1,399 yuan. In dim nighttime hallway environments, the camera has 4 infrared fill lights and automatically switches between low-light full-color and black-and-white night vision modes, so details outside can be seen in dark scenes. On JD, the Xiaomi Smart Door Lock 5 large-screen peephole edition has a final price of 1,399 yuan, with a 0.9 yuan coupon available. The whole series offers 11 unlocking methods, covering AI fingerprint, long-term password, guest password, WeChat mini program, phone Bluetooth, remote unlocking, mechanical key, as well as Xiaomi phone / watch / band NFC and NFC cards, adapting to the usage habits of different family members such as elderly people, children, and guests. IT之家 learned that both products use a dual-mode smart power supply design: a built-in 5,000mAh lithium battery provides 4 months of battery life, and with 4 AA alkaline batteries it provides 6 months of battery life; when the lithium battery level is ≤10%, a low-battery reminder is automatically pushed. Both the inside and outside of the lock have Type-C ports; the outdoor port can connect to a power bank for emergency power to temporarily unlock, and the indoor port can connect to a power bank for continuous charging or directly to a power source for long-term power supply.
items.why_zh: 推测：这显示 AI 指纹识别、智能猫眼和远程开锁等功能继续进入主流价位智能门锁，市场竞争集中在便利性与家庭适用性。
items.why_en: Speculation: this shows features such as AI fingerprint recognition, smart peepholes, and remote unlocking continuing to enter mainstream-priced smart locks, with competition focused on convenience and family suitability.

items.title_zh: 小鹏 MONA 全系累计交付汽车突破 40 万台，平均月交付近 1.5 万台
items.title_en: XPeng MONA series cumulative deliveries exceed 400,000 vehicles, averaging nearly 15,000 per month
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，在 2026 广州车展上，小鹏汽车公布 MONA 系列市场数据： 全系累计交付量突破 40 万辆 ，平均月交付量接近 1.5 万辆。 此外，MONA L03 海外订单已突破 3.4 万辆，并在欧洲、亚太、中东和拉美等地区同步交付。MONA L05 即将开启海外上市，预计今年 12 月登陆泰国，明年 1 月于布鲁塞尔车展开启全欧上市。 据IT之家此前报道，2024 年 4 月 25 日， 小鹏汽车公布全新品牌 MONA ，寓意 Made Of New AI，定位全球 AI 智驾汽车普及者。 2024 年 8 月 27 日，小鹏 MONA M03 上市，售价 11.98 万元起；同月 30 日开启首批交付。 延伸阅读 目前 MONA 系列已形成三款车型的产品矩阵：MONA M03 为智能纯电掀背轿跑，MONA L03 是小鹏 MONA 系列首款全球车型（SUV），MONA L05 则定位为智能时尚大五座 SUV。 国内销量方面，MONA L03 于 2026 年 10 月拿下 10 万元以上纯电 SUV 销量冠军。 MONA L03 于 2026 年 7 月 16 日在德国慕尼黑全球上市，面向全球 65 个国家开启销售，国内市场起售价 12.38 万元，提供纯电及超级增程两种动力版本。 MONA L05 于 2026 年 10 月 15 日在广州开启中国预售，预售价 16.98 万元起，提供纯电和超级增程两种动力形式；正式上市后限时价 13.98 万元起。 海外市场方面，MONA L03 自 2026 年 7 月慕尼黑上市以来，已陆续进入法国、荷兰、意大利等欧洲市场，截至 2026 年 9 月底欧洲订单突破 1.2 万辆；同年 11 月，MONA L03 与 G9L 一同在英国上市，MONA L03 英国起售价为 32990 英镑。 此外，在 2026 广州车展上，MONA L05 和 MONA L03 还首次线下展示了全新新月银 ROAM 套装，该套装将赛博朋克元素与车辆外观相结合，以强化车型的个性化视觉效果。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 27 that at the 2026 Guangzhou auto show, XPeng announced market data for the MONA series: cumulative deliveries of the full lineup exceeded 400,000 vehicles, with average monthly deliveries approaching 15,000. In addition, overseas orders for the MONA L03 have exceeded 34,000 vehicles, with deliveries underway simultaneously in Europe, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East, and Latin America. The MONA L05 is about to begin overseas launches, expected to land in Thailand this December and to start an all-Europe launch at the Brussels auto show in January next year. According to IT之家’s earlier report, on April 25, 2024, XPeng announced the new brand MONA, meaning Made Of New AI, positioned as a popularizer of global AI smart-driving cars. On August 27, 2024, the XPeng MONA M03 was launched at a price starting from 119,800 yuan; first deliveries began on August 30 of the same month. Further reading shows that the MONA series now forms a three-model product matrix: the MONA M03 is a smart pure electric hatchback coupe, the MONA L03 is the first global model (SUV) in the XPeng MONA series, and the MONA L05 is positioned as a smart fashion large five-seat SUV. In terms of domestic sales, the MONA L03 won the sales champion for pure electric SUVs above 100,000 yuan in October 2026. The MONA L03 had its global launch in Munich, Germany, on July 16, 2026, with sales in 65 countries worldwide; its domestic market starting price is 123,800 yuan, and it offers pure electric and super range-extended powertrain versions. The MONA L05 opened Chinese pre-sales in Guangzhou on October 15, 2026, with a pre-sale price starting from 169,800 yuan, offering pure electric and super range-extended powertrains; after its official launch, the limited-time price starts from 139,800 yuan. In overseas markets, since its Munich launch in July 2026, the MONA L03 has successively entered European markets such as France, the Netherlands, and Italy; by the end of September 2026, European orders exceeded 12,000 vehicles. In November of the same year, the MONA L03 and G9L were launched together in the UK, with the MONA L03 starting at £32,990 in the UK. In addition, at the 2026 Guangzhou auto show, the MONA L05 and MONA L03 also showed for the first time offline the new Crescent Silver ROAM package, which combines cyberpunk elements with the vehicle’s exterior to strengthen the model’s personalized visual effect.
items.why_zh: 推测：突破 40 万辆显示 MONA 系列规模扩张，海外订单与上市计划也显示其全球化推进；相关数据来自车企公布，尚需独立验证。
items.why_en: Speculation: surpassing 400,000 vehicles indicates scale expansion for the MONA series, and overseas orders and launch plans also point to globalization progress; the data comes from the automaker and still needs independent verification.

items.title_zh: 曹操出行与阿联酋拉斯海马交通管理局达成合作，将在当地开展 Robotaxi 试点
items.title_en: Caocao Mobility partners with Ras Al Khaimah transport authority to pilot Robotaxi
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，曹操出行宣布已与阿联酋拉斯海马交通管理局（RAKTA）签署合作备忘录，双方计划在拉斯海马指定区域开展自动驾驶车辆测试及试点，探索 Robotaxi 在载人接驳等场景的应用。 在合作分工方面， 曹操出行将提供自动驾驶载人车辆和物流车辆，以及相关技术和运营支持，负责车辆运营及维护，并根据需要为当地相关人员提供培训 。RAKTA 将提供指定区域测试与试点所需的支持，协调当地运营要求，确保测试活动符合场地安全及准入管理要求。同时，曹操出行、RAKTA 将与 K2 集团旗下出行运营商 LUMO 协同合作，整合各方技术、运营及本地资源，共同推进自动驾驶服务在拉斯海马的测试与应用落地。 IT之家注意到，在海外市场布局方面，曹操出行此前已与阿布扎比投资办公室签署合作备忘录，并与阿联酋当地科技公司 K2 集团达成战略合作，共同推进 Robotaxi 项目部署及运营。 此外，曹操出行还与全球自动驾驶技术企业 May Mobility 达成战略合作，将围绕 Robotaxi 部署开展联合研究与商业化探索，推进欧洲等市场的试点项目落地。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 27: Caocao Mobility announced it has signed a memorandum of understanding with the UAE's Ras Al Khaimah Transport Authority (RAKTA) to conduct autonomous vehicle testing and pilots in designated areas of Ras Al Khaimah, exploring Robotaxi use in passenger shuttle and other scenarios. Under the division of work, Caocao Mobility will supply autonomous passenger and logistics vehicles plus related technology and operational support, handle vehicle operations and maintenance, and provide training to local personnel as needed; RAKTA will provide support required for testing and pilots in the designated areas, coordinate local operating requirements, and ensure activities comply with site safety and access rules. The two sides will also work with LUMO, a mobility operator under the K2 Group, combining technology, operations and local resources. Caocao Mobility previously signed an MoU with the Abu Dhabi Investment Office and a strategic cooperation with UAE tech company K2 Group, and also struck a strategic partnership with May Mobility on joint research and commercialization around Robotaxi deployment, advancing pilots in markets including Europe.
items.why_zh: 推测：这是中国 Robotaxi 运营商在海外落地的一次具体尝试，若推进顺利，可能为自动驾驶载人服务在阿联酋的测试提供运营样本；目前仍处于备忘录与试点阶段。
items.why_en: Speculative: this is a concrete overseas move by a Chinese Robotaxi operator and, if it proceeds, could provide an operating reference for autonomous passenger service testing in the UAE; it remains at the MoU and pilot stage.

items.title_zh: 曝谷歌第 10 代 TPU 芯片将配备 512GB 定制 HBM5 内存
items.title_en: Korean report: Google's 10th-gen TPU to pack 512GB of custom HBM5 memory
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，韩媒 Economy Tribune 当地时间今日爆料称， Google（谷歌）计划为其第 10 代 TPU 芯片配备 512GB 的定制 HBM5 内存 。 谷歌 TPU 是当前最主要的 AI ASIC 产品，其规格可作为窥视未来 AI 芯片竞争的窗口。 从各位消息人士的近期泄露来看， TPU 10 当下指的是代号 "Quillfish" 的项目 ，预计由联发科技 (MediaTek) 负责设计服务工作，有望继续采用 Intel（英特尔）的 EMIB-T 先进封装，量产时间点落在 2029 年。由于还有约 3 年的时间，一切情况都可能发生变化。 谷歌近期在原版 TPU 8 系列的基础上推出 8tx、8i Max 两款芯片。此次更新并未在裸片的层面进行调整，而是通过封装集成、系统设计扩展了原有产品的边界。 参考 https://www.economytribune.co.kr/news/articleView.html ?idxno=3904543
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 27: South Korean outlet Economy Tribune reported that day that Google plans to equip its 10th-generation TPU chip with 512GB of custom HBM5 memory. Google's TPU is currently a leading AI ASIC product, and its specifications serve as a window into future AI chip competition. Recent leaks from multiple sources indicate that TPU 10 currently refers to a project codenamed "Quillfish", expected to have design services handled by MediaTek, likely continuing to use Intel's EMIB-T advanced packaging, with mass production targeted for 2029; with roughly three years to go, anything could change. Google recently launched the 8tx and 8i Max chips on top of the original TPU 8 series; the update did not change the die level but extended the existing products through packaging integration and system design.
items.why_zh: 推测：若爆料属实，512GB 定制 HBM5 意味着单芯片内存容量大幅提升，反映 AI ASIC 的内存配置竞赛；该消息未经谷歌确认。
items.why_en: Speculative: if accurate, 512GB of custom HBM5 would mean a large jump in per-chip memory capacity, reflecting a memory-spec race among AI ASICs; the report has not been confirmed by Google.

items.title_zh: 消息称韩国政府要求三星电子开发 Jetson Thor 竞品，企业方反应谨慎
items.title_en: Report: South Korean Government Asks Samsung to Develop a Jetson Thor Competitor; Samsung Responds Cautiously
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，韩媒 MTN 近日报道称，韩国政府今年 10 月对三星电子提出要求，希望这家本土企业能 开发一款可在机器人算力芯片领域与 NVIDIA（英伟达）Jetson Thor 竞争的产品 ，但三星电子的反应谨慎。 韩国将物理 AI 视为自身国家战略的关键部分。在增强机器人整机制造能力外，实现算力基座的国产化也是韩国政府的目标之一。英伟达的 Jetson 系列平台目前是物理 AI 和机器人领域的主导方案。 不过对于三星而言，这一任务并不轻松：韩国国内市场有限，如果想要在该项目盈利必须扩展全球销路；英伟达一路走来，在物理 AI 生态上具备显著的先发优势；三星电子负责芯片设计的系统 LSI 业务深陷亏损，不得不谨慎开案。 参考 https://news.mtn.co.kr/article/2026112315552092178 https://news.mtn.co.kr/article/2026112409573634070
items.summary_en: According to IT Home on November 27, South Korean media outlet MTN recently reported that the South Korean government asked Samsung Electronics in October this year to develop a product that could compete with NVIDIA's Jetson Thor in the robot computing chip sector, but Samsung responded cautiously. South Korea views physical AI as a key part of its national strategy. In addition to strengthening robot system manufacturing capabilities, localizing the computing foundation is also one of the South Korean government's goals. NVIDIA's Jetson platform series is currently the dominant solution in physical AI and robotics. However, this task is not easy for Samsung: South Korea's domestic market is limited, and expanding global sales is necessary if the project is to be profitable; NVIDIA has built a significant first-mover advantage in the physical AI ecosystem over time; and Samsung Electronics' System LSI business, which is responsible for chip design, is mired in losses and must therefore be cautious about starting the project.
items.why_zh: 推测：若报道属实，这反映韩国希望在物理 AI 的机器人算力芯片上推进国产化、降低对英伟达依赖的政策意图。
items.why_en: Speculation: if the report is accurate, it reflects a policy intent by South Korea to promote localization of robot computing chips for physical AI and reduce reliance on NVIDIA.
